segments.name: Biopharmaceutical research and development
segments.description: Develops novel, orally administered small-molecule therapeutics for obesity and related metabolic disorders.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has a single reportable and operating segment related to biopharmaceutical research and development.

revenueModel.text: The company recognizes revenue from collaboration agreements through milestone achievements; it has generated minimal product revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized revenue through its Collaboration Agreement with Solasia Pharma K.K. primarily due to the achievement of milestones.

changes.text: In 2025, the company shifted from being a clinical-stage oncology-focused cell therapy company to a preclinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on obesity and metabolic disorders.
changes.evidence: We were previously a clinical-stage oncology-focused cell therapy company developing adoptive TCR-T cell therapies.
